attribution: Repeated warm table acquisition is material overhead. A warm bind costs about 0.58 microseconds, around 7.8% of the approximately 7.4 microsecond serialized reference-floor physical advance measured in F-AHL27 timing. FMR performs that acquisition once per adaptive physical advance.
repair_constraint: Memoize only immutable adaptive table acquisition. Continue to bind the authoritative analytical fallback with the current step duration so near-saturation timestep-dependent semantics remain correct.
nonclaims: The measured bind cost is host/compiler specific.
